degradation.

input.query: WITH t AS (SELECT * FROM abnormal_traces), s AS (SELECT p.trace_id, p.span_id, p.service_name, p.duration, p.span_name, (SELECT coalesce(sum(c.duration),0) FROM t c WHERE c.trace_id=p.trace_id AND c.parent_span_id=p.span_id) child_sum FROM t p WHERE p.attr_span_kind='Server') SELECT service_name, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) srv_ms, round(avg(child_sum)/1e6,1) child_ms, round(avg(duration-child_sum)/1e6,1) self_ms FROM s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY self_ms DESC
